_why:
The spec marks `creditCard` and `creditCardHolderInfo` as mandatory in PaymentPayWithCreditCardRequestDTO. The real Asaas does NOT require them: paying with an already tokenized card is sending only `creditCardToken` — which is exactly the point of tokenization (the PAN does not travel again).

Proven against the real sandbox:
  POST /v3/payments/{id}/payWithCreditCard  {"creditCardToken":"f19c0055-…"}
  → 200, status CONFIRMED, with the `creditCard` object back in the response.

While the `required` was in the schema, Elysia rejected the body BEFORE the handler:
  {"errors":[{"code":"invalid_creditCard","description":"Expected required property"}, …]}

The handler (`payExistingWithCard`) already knows how to accept a token OR a card — it was only the schema blocking the door. Same defect as overlay 004, at the other end of the card flow.
_source: capture against sandbox.asaas.com/api/v3 on 2026-07-14 (paying a charge with only creditCardToken → 200 CONFIRMED)
